content.comment_body: There's another issue: the new module operates with [version_no] 8.3, while the older one uses [version_no] 8.1. As a result, the network connection control in my program does not allow communication between the two modules when I need it to work.

It is possible to enable communication between devices with [version_no] 8.1 and [version_no] 8.3. You need to permit S7 access for [version_no] 8.3 in [product_name] [version_no] under file properties (general) settings.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces a network communication issue between modules running different firmware versions, specifically [version_no] 8.1 and [version_no] 8.3. The default configurations on the newer module appear to block inter-device connectivity, prompting confusion over compatibility and necessary configuration changes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates straightforward network communication between modules running different firmware versions, expecting cross-device interaction to work seamlessly within their program.
